_doc: Poses used by the actor link system (engine/characters/links.js, notation `link:<carrier>:<mode>`). Arm poses of the carrier (carrying_*) are layered over its own legs/walk; poses of the linked actor (carried_*, cradled, hugging, dragged) replace its pose. Authored for the engine's RIGHT side (s=+1, armR, +x); the engine mirrors them for side L. Hands/arms are then solved by IK (armToward) so these are the fallback + leg/head data. Same format as anims.json.
